title: Luciano Hang Did Not Donate to Flávio Bolsonaro
seoTitle: Luciano Hang Did Not Donate to Flávio Bolsonaro
subtitle: The Havan businessman registered R$300,000 in donations, but not to the senator's campaign
excerpt: Luciano Hang, owner of Havan, did not donate to Flávio Bolsonaro's 2026 campaign. Despite allocating R$1 million to Jair Bolsonaro in 2022, the businessman.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Luciano Hang, owner of Havan, did not donate to Flávio Bolsonaro's 2026 campaign. Despite having allocated R$1 million to Jair Bolsonaro in 2022, the businessman registered R$300,000 in donations this year, directed to state and federal deputy candidates.

What Changed in Hang's Funding

In 2022, Hang disbursed approximately R$1.6 million for electoral campaigns, with R$1 million going directly to Jair Bolsonaro's candidacy. In the current election, he registered only R$300,000, all allocated to candidacies for the Chamber of Deputies and state legislative assemblies.

Why the Absence of Donation Drew Attention

Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign concentrates most of its resources on party transfers. While individual donations represent a smaller portion, the lack of contribution from Hang to the senator's candidacy raises curiosity, as he had strong support for the president in 2022.

Who Funds Flávio Bolsonaro's Campaign

The main financier of Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign is the Liberal Party itself, which transferred approximately R$53.5 million until September 24, representing the majority of the R$56.9 million declared by the campaign. Among the largest individual donors are Erasmo Carlos Battistella, who allocated R$500,000; Walter Schlatter, with R$300,000; Waldemar Verdi Junior, with R$180,000; Marco Antonio Branquinho Junior, with R$125,000; Taicia Fofanoff Junqueira, with R$122,000; and Alexandre Ribeiro Chequer, with R$120,000.

How Electoral Funding Works

Brazilian campaigns can receive funds from different sources authorized by electoral legislation. Corporations cannot make electoral donations since 2015, following a decision by the Supreme Federal Court. Individuals can contribute within the limits established by law. The amounts registered in financial statements allow for identifying how much each candidate received and the declared origin of the funds.

What to Expect in Upcoming Updates

Financial statements may still receive updates before the definitive consolidation of electoral data, potentially altering the funding landscape for Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy.
